text:
deploy-bot: ✅ Deploy complete: release v3.14.0 -> prod/us-west
deploy-bot: Starting post-deploy smoke tests (synth probes + healthchecks). Release notes: https://redwood.example/releases/v3.14.0

alex: noticed embed synth p95 jumped to ~420ms on the initial run (baseline ~150-180ms). Few traces show kv-cache cold starts.

sam: is this regional? my quick check shows eu probes are green, us-west has the slow hosts. canary summary: 8/10 probes OK, 2 probes slow (>300ms).

maria: hmm. sounds like a warmup/kv-prefill issue for the new model variant. can we pin routing to model-variant embed-v1 for now? hold rollout while we investigate? :warning:

jin: running runbook step 1 (increase synth sampling and raise temp threshold)
jin: command: `./infra/synthctl set-rate --region us-west --rate 1m`
jin: command: `./infra/synthctl set-threshold --metric embed_p95 --value 350`
jin: output: OK — synth frequency increased, threshold raised to 350ms.

deploy-bot: synth run: 15 probes (us-west) -> 13 OK, 2 slow. p95 aggregated = 280ms after threshold bump. error rate steady at 0.1% (baseline 0.07%).

alex: p95 improved but still above baseline. I don't love letting this run. proposal: pin route to embed-v1 (v3.13.4 model bundle) for the next 30m and continue investigating kv warmup strategy.

maria: +1 to pin and hold. we'll also add a note in the release changelog and mark this as 'postdeploy: synth variance' so CS/ops are aware.

sam: +1 :thumbsup: — can you also open a quick telemetry capture (traces + kv hit rate) for the affected hosts?

jin: opening trace capture. running: `deployctl pin-route --service embedding --to model:embed-v1 --duration 30m --reason "postdeploy synth p95 elevated"`
jin: pin response: ACCEPTED (pin id pid-20250315-42).

maria: I'll update the release notes and put a small banner in #status: "Holding v3.14.0 rollout in us-west; pinned to v3.13.4 for 30m due to elevated embed p95 on synthetic probes."

deploy-bot: action log: pin applied (pid-20250315-42). Extra synth sampling scheduled.

alex: action items
- continue monitoring p95 & kv hit-rate (alex + sam)
- run a controlled warmup plan for embed-v2 (jin)
- update release notes + internal banner (maria)
- if p95 back to baseline within 30m, resume rollout. otherwise rollback full region.

maria: I'll call this a hold/monitor — will post an update in 15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: thanks team. ping me if you want me to open rollback.

jin: started investigating model weight warmup and prefill windows, will post findings in 10m.

deploy-bot: reminder: hold timer expires in 30m unless extended.

alex: ACK — holding for now.
